verdict.rationale: Elicit documents export of tables to CSV/Excel/RIS/BIB, research reports to PDF/Word (DOCX), and reference-manager compatible RIS/BIB export/import for Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote; pricing page also confirms 'Export to RIS, CSV, BIB, PDF and DOCX.' This covers documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager formats as requested. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of export fidelity beyond vendor docs.
